# Installation of MFD

MFD depends on [MESuSiE](https://github.com/borangao/MESuSiE), which must be installed manually from GitHub before installing MFD. All other dependencies (`susieR`, `data.table`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`) are available on CRAN and will be installed automatically.

## Step 1: Install MESuSiE

```r
devtools::install_github("borangao/MESuSiE")
```

## Step 2: Install MFD

```r
devtools::install_github("gchen4422/MFD")
```
